note_en: Per-call USD ranges observed while building this dataset (N=4 slots x 2 prompt variants = 8 calls per config). Actual cost varies strongly with effort tier; treat these as planning ranges, not quotes. basis: observed = measured on our own runs; plan = flat-rate subscription, zero marginal cost; estimated = list-price ballpark, not yet run.
note_zh: 构建本数据集时实测的每次调用美元区间(每 config = N=4 槽位 × 2 提示变体 = 8 次调用)。实际开销随 effort 档位差异极大,仅作预算参考。basis: observed=实测;plan=订阅制零边际成本;estimated=按牌价估算、尚未实跑。

entries.note_en: Official /responses, background mode. Averaged ~$0.45/call across effort tiers on gpt-5.4 / 5.4-mini / 5.2-codex; xhigh on full-size models reaches ~$2/call. gpt-5.6 family not yet measured, expected higher.
